title: Melody of the Mourning Veil
description: A surreal night scene features a large black grand piano floating in a starry sky above a rural landscape with red barns, a wooden fence, and a winding stream. A hooded woman with a tearful face and green floral veil emerges from the piano, blue musical notes flowing from her eyes and mouth into the colorful swirling sky.
prompt: Surreal night scene with a giant black grand piano floating in a cosmic sky filled with blue, yellow and red swirling nebulae and stars. A woman with a tearful face wearing a green hooded cloak covered in leaves emerges from the piano, blue musical notes flowing from her eyes and mouth. Below is a dark rural landscape with red barns, bare trees, a wooden fence, and a winding stream under a crescent moon.
